description: OPFData, published by OPFData authors / Google DeepMind, provides solved AC optimal-power-flow instances with load and topological perturbations for machine-learning research. Coverage: Solved AC-OPF benchmark grids include load and topological perturbations; this is a simulation benchmark, not an observed national grid inventory. The linked provider page supplies documentation and the access route; no resource files were downloaded. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Price and access terms require confirmation unless explicitly stated above. Availability of the paper alone does not test the data files. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
